title: ever EZRA| Thigh-High Slit Tulip Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This dress was made for moments that matter. The wrap-style bodice softly frames the neckline while offering just enough coverage, and the tulip sleeves add a romantic, elegant touch without drawing too much attention.

Designed with gentle ruching at the waist and a high slit that moves with you, it’s the kind of piece that makes you feel comfortable and confident—whether you’re attending a wedding, formal dinner, or evening celebration. The silhouette is sleek but forgiving, crafted to flatter in all the right places.

Slip it on, add a pair of heels, and you’re set for a night to remember.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises knit.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
